description_en: Queries the corpus list of a specified project
description_zh: 查询指定项目语料列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-speech-list --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --audio-format wav --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySpeechList

parameters.help_en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID
parameters.name: project_code

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回的语料条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number, starting from 1. Maximum value: 10000
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page of the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
></notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported
parameters.name: audio_format
